meta.name: Bachke Rehna Re Baba
meta.description: Rukmini, well into her 40s and still unmarried, teams up with her orphaned niece Padmini to con wealthy men out of their money. They do succeed for a while, amassing a fortune under various names and disguises, until Padmini falls in love with one of her targets.  An unofficial remake of the 2001 film Heartbreakers.
